_comment: Maps each contest to its identifier on every venue. Hand-maintained; there
is no way to generate this automatically.
Polymarket structures these as separate binary markets per party rather
than one multi-outcome market, so polymarket_outcome is always 'Yes' and
the slug identifies which party. Pick the slug matching yes_side.
'yes_side' names the outcome every source's probability refers to. Every
venue for a race must resolve to P(yes_side wins). Getting this wrong
silently inverts a race, so ingest verifies the named outcome exists
Kalshi tickers still to be filled in. Kalshi appears to name series per
state per cycle (SENATEGA, SENATEAL) rather than one control series, so
Leave kalshi_ticker null until confirmed; ingest skips null venues.
